== Summary ==

Same area (x 112–717, y 823–1039) cropped from each published image <code>riseofthesith.gif</code>; pixels unchanged. Made by placing the two unscaled crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
